BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'submission_mode'
          AND data_type IN ('character varying', 'text')
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN submission_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN submission_mode TYPE smallint
            USING CASE UPPER(BTRIM(submission_mode))
                WHEN 'SNAPSHOT' THEN 1
                WHEN 'ANSWER_PAYLOAD' THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

UPDATE task
SET submission_mode = COALESCE(submission_mode, 1);

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET DEFAULT 1,
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
